name: wishhive-rules-tests
description: Firestore security rules and Cloud Functions regression suites for WishHive.

scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix ../functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-wishhive --config ../firebase.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 functions.test.mjs functions.callables.test.mjs"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run settle && npm run test:functions
